last_narration:
The cane comes down and the rat goes still beneath it — but the same swing is still carrying through when the bank beside you tears open and the Rat Mother comes out of it, vast and shrieking, the dog already snarling in at your side to meet her.

You swing for the Rat Mother and she's already turned from where you aimed.

The dog gets under her guard and rips into her flank.

The Rat Mother heaves and another rat comes spilling out of the nest at her side, then goes rigid with the effort.

The new rat snaps at the dog and catches only fur.

You catch the rat with the cane and it staggers sideways.

The dog's jaws close on it and shake it hard.

The Rat Mother stands frozen, spent, not moving.

The rat lunges for the dog's leg and misses.

You strike again and the rat reels.

The dog snaps at it and comes up empty.

The Rat Mother still hasn't moved.

The rat gets its teeth into the dog's flank and it yelps.

You bring the cane down on it again, hard.

The dog seizes it and snaps it still with one shake.

The Rat Mother surges back into the fight and catches the dog a heavy blow.

You swing at her and miss clean.

The dog tears into her side again.

She turns on the dog and doesn't connect.

You get the cane in on her for a solid hit.

The dog goes for her again and bites deep.

She swings for the dog and misses.

You swing and she's already moved.

The dog catches her again, worrying at the wound.

She lunges for the dog and doesn't find it.

Your swing goes wide.

The dog snaps at her and misses.

She swings for the dog and it isn't there.

Your footing goes on the blood-slick ground and the swing meant for her goes wide instead.

The dog goes for her again and comes away empty-jawed.

She turns on the dog once more and misses.

You find your feet and swing again, and she's already clear of it.

The dog tears into her once more and she staggers under it.

She catches the dog hard as it presses back in.

You swing at her and miss again.

The dog locks its jaws into her throat and doesn't let go until she stops moving.
